skill.name: miro-automation
skill.description: Automate Miro board workflows through Rube MCP with guidance for boards, items, sharing, connectors, and pagination.
skill.summary: Use Rube MCP to manage Miro boards, items, sharing, and connectors with current tool schemas.
skill.author: sickn33

security_audit.summary: The shell-execution findings are false positives caused by Markdown backticks around Miro tool names, parameters, and examples. The only confirmed issue is the external Rube MCP endpoint, which is a low-risk network trust boundary for Miro OAuth and board data. The system-reconnaissance findings are false positives on Miro API terminology.

remediation.suggestion: Disclose that users must connect to Rube MCP and review Rube, Composio, and Miro permissions before authorizing access.

remediation.issue: Board sharing can invite unintended recipients
remediation.suggestion: Add guidance to confirm email addresses and use viewer or commenter roles unless editor access is required.
Keep tool names clear, but consider reducing unnecessary inline backticks around prose-only parameter descriptions.

static_findings.snippet: - Active Miro connection via `RUBE_MANAGE_CONNECTIONS` with toolkit `miro`
- Always call `RUBE_SEARCH_TOOLS` first to get current tool schemas
**Get Rube MCP**: Add `https://rube.app/mcp` as an MCP server in your client configuration. No API k
1. Verify Rube MCP is available by confirming `RUBE_SEARCH_TOOLS` responds
2. `MIRO_GET_BOARD` - Get detailed info for a specific board [Optional]
- `query`: Search term to filter boards by name
- `board_id`: Specific board ID for detailed retrieval
2. `MIRO_CREATE_STICKY_NOTE_ITEM` - Add sticky notes to a board [Optional]
- `board_id`: Target board ID (required for all item creation)
- `data`: Content object with `content` field for sticky note text
- `style`: Styling object with `fillColor` for sticky note color
- `board_id` is required for ALL item operations; resolve via GET_BOARDS2 first
- Sticky note colors use hex codes (e.g., '#FF0000') in the `fillColor` field
- Frame items require `geometry` with both width and height
1. `MIRO_GET_BOARD_ITEMS` - List all items on a board [Required]
- Results are paginated; follow `cursor` until absent for complete item list
- `emails`: Array of email addresses to invite
- `startItem`: Object with `id` of the source item
- `endItem`: Object with `id` of the target item
- Use `position: {x: 0, y: 0}` for center of board
**Get Rube MCP**: Add `https://rube.app/mcp` as an MCP server in your client configuration. No API k
- Email addresses must be valid; invalid emails cause the entire request to fail
1. Call MIRO_GET_BOARD_ITEMS with board_id and optional type filter
3. Extract item id for further operations

content.user_title: Automate Miro Boards with Rube MCP
content.value_statement: Miro workflows often require repeated board setup, item creation, and sharing steps. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through Rube MCP tool sequences.
actual_capabilities: Find accessible Miro boards and retrieve board details.
Create boards, sticky notes, frames, and bulk board items.
List board items and connectors with pagination guidance.
Share boards with users and verify board members.
Resolve board and item IDs before running Miro operations.
Explain Miro coordinates, rate limits, and response parsing pitfalls.
limitations: Requires Rube MCP and an active Miro OAuth connection.
Does not include executable scripts or a custom Miro API client.
Depends on current tool schemas returned by Rube MCP.
Cannot bypass Miro permissions, organization policies, or API limits.

use_cases.title: Prepare Planning Boards
use_cases.description: Create a board, add planning frames, and place sticky notes for roadmap discussions.

use_cases.title: Organize Workshops
use_cases.description: Build structured frames, group notes by topic, and connect related ideas before a session.

use_cases.title: Manage Board Access
use_cases.description: Find a board, share it with collaborators, and check current member access.

prompt_templates.title: Find a Board
prompt_templates.prompt: Use Rube MCP to search my Miro boards for the project name I provide. Show the most likely match and explain why.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Workshop Board
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a new Miro board for a team workshop. Add frames for agenda, ideas, decisions, and next steps.

prompt_templates.title: Populate an Existing Board
prompt_templates.prompt: Find my existing Miro board, resolve its board ID, then add grouped sticky notes and frames from my outline.

prompt_templates.title: Audit and Connect Board Items
prompt_templates.prompt: List all items on a large Miro board with pagination. Identify related items, review connectors, and suggest missing connections.

output_examples.input: Find my roadmap board and tell me which one to use.
output: Searched accessible boards using the provided name.
Identified the closest matching board with its owner and last modified context.
Recommended confirming the board before making changes.

output_examples.input: Create a retrospective board with sections for wins, risks, actions, and owners.
output: Created a new board using the requested retrospective structure.
Added four frames with clear section labels.
Prepared sticky note placement so the board opens ready for team input.

output_examples.input: Share the design review board with three reviewers as commenters.
output: Resolved the target board before sharing.
Prepared commenter access for the supplied email addresses.
Checked board members after sharing to confirm access.

best_practices: Search Rube MCP tools first so requests use current Miro schemas.
Resolve board names to board IDs before creating or updating items.
Use least-privilege sharing roles and confirm recipients before inviting them.
anti_patterns: Do not hardcode board IDs across accounts or workspaces.
Do not create many individual items when bulk creation is available.
Do not assume all board item responses contain the same fields.

faq.question: Does this skill require a Miro account?
faq.answer: Yes. You need a Miro account connected through Rube MCP before workflows can access boards.

faq.question: Does this skill store Miro credentials?
faq.answer: No. The skill is documentation. Authentication is handled by Rube MCP and Miro OAuth.

faq.question: Can it create new board content?
faq.answer: Yes. It guides creation of boards, sticky notes, frames, bulk items, and connectors when tools allow it.

faq.question: Can it manage board sharing?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes guidance for sharing boards and checking members, subject to Miro permissions.

faq.question: Why should tools be searched first?
faq.answer: Rube MCP tool schemas can change. Searching first helps the assistant use current parameter names.

faq.question: Is there a security consideration?
faq.answer: Yes. Users must trust the configured Rube MCP endpoint and review Miro permissions before connecting.
